title: Cucumber raita
description: A cool, simple yogurt side with cucumber and coriander for pulao night.
imageAlt: Warm editorial photograph of creamy cucumber raita with sliced cucumber and coriander in a speckled bowl.
personalNote: Use whatever yogurt is left in the pot after measuring out the five tablespoons for the chicken pulao.
importantNotes: One cucumber is more than enough. Add it a little at a time so the raita stays creamy rather than watery.

ingredients.name: Plain yogurt
ingredients.note: whatever is left after making the chicken pulao

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.note: thinly sliced; you may not need it all

steps.title: Slice and chop
steps.description: Thinly slice the cucumber and finely chop the coriander leaves.
steps.doneness: Thin cucumber slices and finely chopped coriander.
steps.tip: Start with half the cucumber; one whole cucumber is more than enough for most bowls of yogurt.

steps.title: Mix the raita
steps.description: Put the leftover yogurt in a bowl. Add a pinch of salt, the sliced cucumber and the chopped coriander. Mix everything together gently.
steps.doneness: Creamy yogurt with cucumber and coriander evenly mixed through it.

storage: Keep covered in the fridge and use promptly.
foodSafety: Return the yogurt to the fridge promptly if you are making the raita ahead.
servingSuggestion: Serve with chicken pulao or coconut pulao.
